correctness.rationale: Every nonzero-eigenvalue block trace obstruction is necessary, and the derivation \(t^2d/dt\) descends to precisely the admissible cyclic primary modules, constructing \(X\) over \(\mathbb F_q\). All solutions form affine translates of the commuting algebra. Rational-canonical centralizer unit orders cancel \(q^c\) fibers and yield the Euler product; the \(p\)-threshold follows from block size. Direct original-matrix elimination and exact rational-series extraction agree for \(p=2,n\le3\), \(p=3,n\le3\), \(p=5,n\le2\), and \(q=4,n=2\). Finite tests are not the proof.

originality.rationale: Feinberg 1979 already determines identity-commutator solvability and implies the present invertible-primary block criterion by multiplying by the inverse square of Y; Iyudu supplies translated-centralizer fibers in characteristic zero, Bourgeois provides a modular nonnilpotent example, and classical Feit–Fine techniques supply Euler-type counting weights. These precursors are credited and their consequences are not original. The assessed addition is the explicit all-dimensional characteristic-dependent finite-field Jordan-plane labeled-pair enumerator; no inspected source was found to state or dominate this particular census. This is an exact new application rather than a new proof of the classical criterion. Priority risk from an unlocated existing Ore-extension enumeration persists.

value.rationale: The Jordan plane is a natural representation-theoretic algebra. The characteristic-\(p\) admissibility boundary and exact all-dimensional labeled-point generating product determine a natural and previously unsettled-to-this-search arithmetic invariant, quantify the sharp nonnilpotent transition, and connect geometric strata with finite-field arithmetic. No larger downstream theorem is necessary for value, but this does not classify orbits or prove geometric smoothness.
